title: Easy Crockpot Chicken Fajitas (Meal Prep Burrito Bowls)

ingredients.raw: 2 Chicken Breasts or 1 lb Chicken Tenders
ingredients.name: chicken breasts

ingredients.raw: 12 oz Pico de Gallo or salsa of choice
ingredients.name: pico de gallo

ingredients.raw: 1 c Brown Rice, cooked or steam in a bag
ingredients.name: brown rice

ingredients.raw: Cilantro and minced garlic to taste
ingredients.name: cilantro and garlic

ingredients.raw: Optional: Corn/flour tortillas, fresh greens, avocado, tortilla chips
ingredients.name: tortillas

instructions.text: Place chicken breasts or tenders in a crockpot with the juice of 1 lime, pico de gallo or salsa and taco seasoning to taste. Cook on high, 4-6 hours or on low, 6-8 hours.
Wash and slice the peppers and chop the onion.
Before the last 2 hours of cooking, shred chicken in the crockpot.
Then, add peppers, onion, black beans, corn, cooked brown rice, juice of another lime, and additional taco seasoning (to taste).
Prior to serving, add fresh cilantro to taste.
Stir and enjoy served on tortillas or over fresh greens for a fajita taco salad or burrito bowl.
